action_history.player_action: I review the evidence with Bran and Garran to decide how to identify the faction that backed Captain Voss.
I study the manifest payment marks to trace who funded Captain Voss.
I ask Bran what he knows about the Silver Crow cipher on Voss's payment marks.
I question the old teamster at the wagon yard about the Silver Crow cargo routes.
I travel to the abandoned cooperage to search for the Silver Crow cache.
I inspect the cooperage cellar for hidden doors, cargo marks, or the Silver Crow cache.
I open the hidden Silver Crow cache beneath the cooperage cellar.
I read and decipher the coded Silver Crow ledger from the hidden cache.
I compare the ledger names and seals to identify the Sable Chain agent funding the Silver Crow.
I follow the ledger trail to locate Agent Marlowe before the Sable Chain can erase the evidence.
I confront Agent Marlowe with the Silver Crow ledger and demand the truth about the Sable Chain.
I return to Bran and Garran with proof that the Sable Chain backed Captain Voss through the Silver Crow.
I meet with Bran and Garran to plan how to move against the Sable Chain before they strike back.
I secure the Silver Crow ledger, the manifest, and Marlowe's proof before the Sable Chain can steal them.
I scout the streets around the River Gate safehouse for Sable Chain watchers.
I shadow the Sable Chain watchers from the safehouse to learn where they report.
I follow the watchers to the River Gate warehouses.
I inspect the River Gate warehouse marks, crates, and chalk signs for Sable Chain codes.
I search the warehouse office for Sable Chain countermove orders.
I rush back to warn Bran and Garran that the Sable Chain plans to burn the evidence and silence witnesses.
I help Bran and Garran prepare the safehouse defense and protect the evidence before the Sable Chain strike.
I intercept the Sable Chain strike team before they can burn the safehouse evidence.
I capture the strike team's sealed orders before they can destroy them.
I report to Bran and Garran that the Sable Chain countermove failed and the sealed orders point to a higher handler.
I review the sealed orders with Bran and Garran to identify the higher Sable Chain handler.
I decode the handler's route cipher from the sealed orders.
I warn the east road teamsters that the Sable Chain handler plans to choke the supply route.
I scout the east road for roadblocks, chokepoints, and Sable Chain pressure points.
I disable the false toll markers the Sable Chain placed along the east road.
I search the old milepost for the Sable Chain handler's dead drop.
I read the route pressure instructions from the handler's dead drop.
I travel to Black Ford before the Sable Chain handler's people can seize the crossing.
I confront the Sable Chain route pressure agents at Black Ford and order them to stand down.
I secure the Black Ford crossing so the teamsters can keep the east road open.
I study the captured route papers to identify the Sable Chain handler's signature.
I return to Bran and Garran with the name of the Sable Chain handler: Veska.
I meet with Bran and Garran to plan how to pursue Handler Veska before the Sable Chain relocates.
I trace Veska's courier route from the captured route papers and sealed orders.
I travel to the old north watchpost to follow Veska's courier trail.
I inspect the old north watchpost for courier signs, Sable Chain marks, and Veska's trail.
I intercept Veska's courier before the message can leave the old north watchpost.
I recover Veska's coded message from the intercepted courier.
I decode Veska's coded message to learn where the Sable Chain leadership is moving.
I travel to the ridge hideout before Veska's leadership cell can relocate.
I scout the ridge hideout for guards, exits, and signs of Handler Veska.
I confront Handler Veska at the ridge hideout with the proof linking her to the Sable Chain route pressure.
I secure Veska's leadership ledgers before the Sable Chain can destroy or move them.
I return to Bran and Garran with Veska's leadership ledgers and proof of the Sable Chain command structure.
I review Veska's ledgers with Bran and Garran to map the Sable Chain command structure.
I study the ledger entries to identify the hidden Sable Chain paymaster.

recent_turns.narration: The journey towards the old north watchpost is swift, following faint but distinct tracks that Veska's courier left near the ridge hideout. As you arrive at the dilapidated stone structure, the air here feels colder and more charged than in the open plains. The trail clearly leads directly into the main barracks area of the post itself.
recent_turns.player_action: I travel to the old north watchpost to follow Veska's courier trail.

recent_turns.narration:
The weathered timber and stone of the old north watchpost yield immediate clues to recent activity. Scratched onto the main support beam near the signal firepit, you find faded markings clearly indicating a courier route passage. Closer examination confirms several distinct Sable Chain stamps pressed into the wood, alongside clear impressions matching Handler Veska's heavy boots along the eastern rampart.

Action: Evidence located at watchpost.
recent_turns.player_action: I inspect the old north watchpost for courier signs, Sable Chain marks, and Veska's trail.

recent_turns.narration:
You managed to slip into position just as the runner was about to reach the main gate of the old north watchpost. The courier—a nervous-looking individual bearing a sealed scroll stamped with Handler Veska's insignia—stumbles slightly, allowing you to close the distance before they can make their break for open ground. The message is secure in your grasp, confirming active movement through this vital sector.
Action: Interception successful; Courier detained at the watchpost perimeter.
recent_turns.player_action: I intercept Veska's courier before the message can leave the old north watchpost.

recent_turns.narration: The brittle parchment feels cool beneath your gloved fingers as you carefully extract Veska's message from the courier’s satchel. The ink appears fresh, suggesting the dispatch was made very recently by a runner moving with purpose. As you hold it up to examine the intricate script, you can already discern complex cipher marks woven throughout the text.
recent_turns.player_action: I recover Veska's coded message from the intercepted courier.

recent_turns.narration:
The cipher breaks cleanly under your scrutiny, revealing precise coordinates and cryptic notations about troop movements. Veska wasn't merely passing through; she was coordinating a major tactical shift. The message indicates the Sable Chain leadership is converging on the old Sunken Keep, likely preparing for a decisive action there.
This intelligence paints a clear picture of immediate danger heading toward your current location.
recent_turns.player_action: I decode Veska's coded message to learn where the Sable Chain leadership is moving.

recent_turns.narration: As you move swiftly along the winding path, your approach to the ridge hideout is swift and silent. The familiar timber structure comes into view just as the setting sun casts long shadows across the surrounding scrubland. You reach the edge of the clearing, positioned perfectly to observe the entrance before Veska's cell has a chance to fully mask their movements or depart entirely.
recent_turns.player_action: I travel to the ridge hideout before Veska's leadership cell can relocate.

recent_turns.narration: From your vantage point on the ridge, you manage to peer down into the main area of the hideout without being immediately detected. The shadows conceal most of your movements as you scan for signs of activity and Handler Veska’s passage. You spot several figures milling about near a central fire pit, suggesting guards are present and actively engaged in camp duties.
recent_turns.player_action: I scout the ridge hideout for guards, exits, and signs of Handler Veska.

recent_turns.narration: The ridge hideout falls into a sudden, tense silence as you present the damning proof. Handler Veska’s composure flickers, revealing a momentary crack in her practiced facade of control. She slowly takes the documents from your hand, her eyes scanning the details before meeting your gaze with a challenging intensity. The weight of the Sable Chain's influence suddenly feels heavier in this isolated spot on the ridge.
recent_turns.player_action: I confront Handler Veska at the ridge hideout with the proof linking her to the Sable Chain route pressure.

recent_turns.narration: With a swiftness born of urgency, you managed to secure Veska's official leadership ledgers, tucking them safely away before the lumbering form of the Sable Chain could reach your location. The heavy chain paused momentarily, its metallic presence seeming to hesitate as it registered the removal of the vital documents. You now hold proof of her passage and authority in this contested area.

objectives.summary: find witness
Travel to Garran's wagon yard.
warn garran
Prepare for the mill road by gathering supplies, resting, and securing help.
Leave the wagon yard by the quarry road.
Scout the quarry road for ambush signs.
Identify any watchers or scouts near the route.
Choose how to handle the ambush threat.
Identify who hired the ambushers.
Reach the north road shrine.
Plan how to use the evidence against Captain Voss.
Review the evidence pointing beyond Captain Voss.
Plan the next move against the Sable Chain.
Review the sealed orders naming the Sable Chain handler.
Plan how to pursue Handler Veska.
Review Veska's ledgers to map the Sable Chain command structure.

effect.summary: Review the evidence pointing beyond Captain Voss.

effect.text: The evidence shows Captain Voss had outside backing, but the faction remains unidentified.

effect.summary: Trace the payment marks in the manifest.

effect.text: The payment marks match an old Silver Crow trading cipher.
Ask Bran what he knows about the Silver Crow.

matched_nodes.title: Trace the payment marks from the manifest.

effect.text: Bran says the Silver Crow was a smuggler faction thought to be gone from the region.
Question the old teamster who once hauled Silver Crow cargo.

matched_nodes.title: Ask Bran about the Silver Crow.

effect.text: The old teamster remembers a Silver Crow cache beneath the abandoned cooperage.
Travel to the abandoned cooperage.
The abandoned cooperage is reached.
Inspect the cooperage cellar for the Silver Crow cache.
The cooperage cellar contains a hidden door marked with the Silver Crow cipher.
Open the hidden Silver Crow cache.
The Silver Crow cache contains coded ledgers and faction seals.
Read the coded Silver Crow ledger.
The ledger shows the Silver Crow is now funded by a faction called the Sable Chain.
Identify the Sable Chain agent behind the payments.
The ledger points to Agent Marlowe as the Sable Chain handler behind the payments.
Locate Agent Marlowe before the Sable Chain can erase the trail.
Agent Marlowe's trail leads to a River Gate safehouse.
Confront Agent Marlowe at the safehouse.
Agent Marlowe confirms the Sable Chain used the Silver Crow to fund Voss.
Return to the allies with proof of the Sable Chain connection.
Bran and Garran now have proof that the Sable Chain backed Captain Voss through the Silver Crow.
Plan how to move against the Sable Chain.

matched_nodes.title: Return with proof of the Sable Chain connection.

effect.summary: Plan the next move against the Sable Chain.

effect.text: Bran and Garran expect the Sable Chain to react now that their agent was exposed.
Secure the evidence before the Sable Chain can steal or destroy it.

matched_nodes.title: Plan how to move against the Sable Chain.

effect.summary: Secure the evidence against the Sable Chain.

effect.text: The ledger, manifest, and Marlowe proof are secured under guard.
Watch for Sable Chain agents near the safehouse.

effect.summary: Detect Sable Chain watchers near the safehouse.

effect.text: Two Sable Chain watchers are seen tracking the safehouse exits.
Follow the watchers to learn where they report.
The watchers report toward the old River Gate warehouses.
Travel to the River Gate warehouses.
The River Gate warehouses are reached.
Inspect the warehouse marks for Sable Chain signs.

matched_nodes.title: Travel to the River Gate warehouses.

effect.text: Chalk marks on the crates confirm Sable Chain staging activity.
Find the Sable Chain countermove orders.
Orders reveal the Sable Chain plans to silence witnesses and burn the safehouse evidence.
Warn Bran and Garran about the planned strike.

matched_nodes.title: Find the Sable Chain countermove orders.

Prepare the safehouse defense before the strike begins.

matched_nodes.title: Warn allies about the Sable Chain strike.

Intercept the Sable Chain strike team.

Capture the strike team's sealed orders.

effect.text: The sealed orders name a higher Sable Chain handler coordinating the pressure campaign.
Report the thwarted countermove and prepare to pursue the handler.

effect.text: The Sable Chain countermove is thwarted and a higher handler is now exposed.
Pursue the higher Sable Chain handler.

effect.summary: Review the sealed orders naming the Sable Chain handler.

effect.text: The sealed orders point to a handler using route pressure to isolate the town.
Decode the handler's route cipher.

effect.text: The cipher shows the handler intends to choke the east road supply route.

effect.summary: Scout the east road pressure points.

Disable the false toll markers.

matched_nodes.title: Scout the east road pressure points.

The instructions name Black Ford as the handler's next pressure point.
Travel to Black Ford before the handler's people arrive.

Confront the route pressure agents at Black Ford.
The Sable Chain route pressure agents are stopped at Black Ford.
Secure Black Ford for the teamsters.
Black Ford is secured for the teamsters and the east road remains open.

story_signature.dramatic_question: Can the player turn tavern rumors into a reliable lead before the trail goes cold?
story_signature.premise: The player begins in the Rusty Flagon Tavern after rumors of a witness, a hurried traveler, and possible bandit activity begin to converge.
